trigger.observed: The intended FileNotFoundError occurs. Native owned cleanup then refuses at _check_membership_fence because current.total_processes differs from the admitted _shutdown_total; run_process retains ownership through AudioCleanupPending. Teardown reaches the same Job/fence.
not_observed: Complete native handle or notification inventory
Proof that the new fully verified growth subcase caused this historical failure

source_defect: Current close already drains positive NEW_PROCESS notices and retains membership-verified native handles after termination, but the fence rejects every lifetime change even when all additional exact objects and the complete original lifetime proof are available.

rule.initial_anchor: The original known identity set is captured only by the existing first pre-termination inventory admission. No _admission_failure is cleared and no post-termination PID enumeration is introduced.
rule.growth: Admit only bounded monotonic growth from a complete preserved prior proof, exact current lifetime coverage, and additional identities each positively notified and still backed by a retained IsProcessInJob-verified native handle.
rule.exit: All existing leader and member signal waits, active-count drain and final per-member exit coverage execute unchanged. Partial wait/close failures retain the augmented proof and native handles for the existing cleanup owner.
refusals: Empty inventory or zero active count alone
Positive notice plus OpenProcess ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER only for newly added identities
rule.diagnostics: A refusal adds only fixed numeric counts; it does not log paths, command text, secrets or raw process handles.

tests.native_prerequisites: Actual Windows stdlib/ctypes and current carr_library owner; source or installed origin. No FFmpeg/OCR/model/output endpoint. The workflow must select this module only on Windows; no skip fallback.
tests.native_boundary: Actual Python children are created after the original native snapshot and before Terminate; positive completion notices retain real membership-verified handles. A private owner-only observer delegates every native call once unchanged and records successful native signal/close ordering. Normal return and original FileNotFoundError preservation are separate cases.
tests.observer_scope: Foreign and not-yet-registered Jobs delegate unchanged to the real _retain_members, preserving unrelated cleanup owners.
tests.prior_assertions: All56 existing modeled cases/assertions remain byte-for-byte; current real scandir family tests and all application budgets remain unchanged.

bounded_reuse_review.reason: The donor uses an alternate per-PID terminate/re-enumerate owner with a different launch API and65,536 limit, without this current lifetime/notification proof contract. No compatible narrow fence delta was found; current owner, cap and stronger guards are retained.

primary_api_sources.fact: TotalProcesses covers the job lifetime, including terminated processes and failed associations caused by a limit violation; ActiveProcesses alone is not a per-object signal proof.
Ordinary notifications are not guaranteed; a process identifier can be recycled unless an open handle preserves the object.
Membership is queried using an actual process handle and the exact Job handle.
Job termination applies to associated/nested processes; the existing owner still requires per-process proof.
External termination is asynchronous; a process can retain pending I/O until completion, and confirmed exit requires waiting on its handle.

qualification_limits: No claim that historical missing counters were positive growth or that this patch has passed native execution.
No prior943 Standard/component PASS is transferred to this unexecuted owner change.
No new framework, process supervisor, resource owner, admission policy, deadline or source authority is introduced.
